sections.heading: What Kolto Labs is
sections.body: Kolto is the healing medium of the Old Republic. Kolto Labs builds open-source tools for the Odyssey-engine games.

sections.heading: Why we exist
sections.body: Our released projects are MIT-licensed. Each has one repository, and bugs and feature requests go in its public issues.

sections.heading: Why reverse engineering
sections.body: The original engine is the specification. When a tool disagrees with the game, the tool is wrong. We document engine behaviour from the shipped executables so that patchers, compilers and query tools agree with the game.

projects.name: kq
projects.tagline: Query a KotOR installation like it was plain text.
projects.description: A `jq`/`rg`-style command-line tool for KotOR I & II. It lists resources, resolves which copy the game actually loads across override, modules and BIFs, and prints GFF, 2DA, TLK, NCS, models and textures as outline, gron, JSON or raw bytes.
features: Resolves override / module / BIF precedence exactly like the game
diff and merge for GFF and 2DA
Used, unused and overshadowed resource inventory

install.powershell: powershell -ExecutionPolicy ByPass -c "Set-Item Env:KQ_REPO kolto-labs/kq; irm https://github.com/kolto-labs/kq/releases/download/v0.3.0/install.ps1 | iex"

projects.name: kotor-formats
projects.tagline: One copy of the byte layouts.
projects.description: Shared readers and writers for KotOR I/II formats: `kotor-ncs-isa`, `kotor-ncs` (with a decompiler), `kotor-formats` (GFF, 2DA, TLK, SSF, ERF/RIM) and `kotor-diff`. One copy of the byte layouts, so a patcher, a compiler and a query tool cannot drift apart.

projects.name: Hyperstim
projects.tagline: A script extender for KotOR and TSL.
